## Deflator

The deflator calculation is based on the short rate Rt

```{r fig1, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 5, fig.align = "center", echo=FALSE}

nb_tr=1 #deflator nb

x<-1:length(cube[1,,nb_tr])
visu<-(cube[,,nb_tr])
max<-apply(visu,MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.997)
min<-apply(visu,MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.003)
qet2max<-apply(visu,MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.954)
qet2min<-apply(visu,MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.046)
qetmax<-apply(visu,MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.683)
qetmin<-apply(visu,MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.317)
#mean<-apply(cube[,,nb_tr],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.5)
mean<-apply(visu,MARGIN=2,FUN=mean)

# trac? non-cumul?
plot(NULL,NULL,xlim=c(min(x),max(x)),ylim=c(min(min),max(max)),
         xlab="time",ylab="Rate",main=paste("Quantiles of monetary","",sep=""))
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(max,rev(min)),col="grey",border=NA)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(qet2max,rev(qet2min)),col="lightblue",border=NA)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(qetmax,rev(qetmin)),col="blue",border=NA)
lines(x,mean,type="l",col="red")
legend("topleft", inset=.01, title="Qantiles",
       c(expression(3*sigma),expression(2*sigma),expression(sigma),"av."), fill=c("grey","lightblue","blue","red"), horiz=TRUE, cex=0.6)
```

Deflator must be compared to the price of Zero Coupon Bond  according to the standard deviation of the deflator
Deflator must stay in between limits:
$$ P(0,t) + \frac{q(\frac{x}{2})*SD}{\sqrt{N}}  and  P(0,t) + \frac{q(\frac{1-x}{2})*SD}{\sqrt{N}} $$

then for x = 0.02 (validation limit), and EIOPA curve for time step = 0.5

```{r fig2, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 5, fig.align = "center", echo=FALSE}
norm_inv=2.32634787 #loi normale inverse pour proba de 1%
load(paste(reptravail,"/R4 CALIBRAGE/R4 OUT/Prix_P0t_interp_",sc,".Rda",sep=""))
nb_tr=1 #deflator nb
SD<-apply(cube[,,nb_tr],2,sd)
D<-apply(cube[,,nb_tr],2,mean)

plot(P0t_interp[1:length(D)],type='l',ylim = c(0,1.1), cex = 1.5,col="blue", lty=2, lwd=2, main="Quality test on deflator")
line_up<-(P0t_interp[1:length(D)]+(-norm_inv)*SD/(N^0.5))
lines(line_up, lwd=1)
line_down<-(P0t_interp[1:length(D)]+norm_inv*SD/(N^0.5))
lines(line_down, lwd=1)

lines(D,col='red',cex=3, lwd=2)
legend("topright", inset=.02, title="Defl(t) vs. P(0,t)",
       c("Av. Deflator","P(0,t)","Stat. tolerances"), fill=c("red","blue","black"), horiz=TRUE, cex=0.6)

```
## Equity

Modelized equity protfolio presents 3 different out sets called slices.
One is the total return and the two others are decomposition between dividends and capital change (without div.)

```{r fig3, echo=FALSE}
ListNomActifs<-c("DEFLATOR",paste("ZC_",seq(1:Nb_ZC)),"EQ_CAPITAL_CHANGE","EQ_DIVIDEND","PROP_CAPITAL_CHANGE","PROP_DIVIDEND","INFLATION","EQUITY_TOTAL_RETURN","PROP_TOTAL_RETURN")
par(mfrow = c(2,3))
nb_tr=c(Nb_ZC+2,Nb_ZC+3,Nb_ZC+7)
for (i in 1:length(nb_tr)){
  
x<-1:length(cube[1,,nb_tr[i]])
max<-apply(cube[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.997)
min<-apply(cube[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.003)
qet2max<-apply(cube[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.954)
qet2min<-apply(cube[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.046)
qetmax<-apply(cube[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.683)
qetmin<-apply(cube[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.317)
#mean<-apply(cube[,,nb_tr],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.5)
mean<-apply(cube[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=mean)
# trac? non-cumul?
plot(NULL,NULL,xlim=c(min(x),max(x)),ylim=c(min(min),max(max)),
         xlab="time",ylab="rates",main=paste("Quantiles of ","\n",ListNomActifs[nb_tr[i]],sep=""),cex.main=0.8)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(max,rev(min)),col="grey",border=NA)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(qet2max,rev(qet2min)),col="lightblue",border=NA)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(qetmax,rev(qetmin)),col="blue",border=NA)
lines(x,mean,type="l",col="red")
legend("topleft", inset=.01, title="Qantiles",
       c(expression(3*sigma),expression(2*sigma),expression(sigma),"av."), fill=c("grey","lightblue","blue","red"), horiz=TRUE, cex=0.4)

}

for (i in 1:length(nb_tr)){

#trac? pour la tranche n?
x<-1:length(CumulESGDefl[1,,nb_tr[i]])
max<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.997)
min<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.003)
qet2max<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.954)
qet2min<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.046)
qetmax<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.683)
qetmin<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.317)

# mean<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.5)
mean<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=mean)

# trac?
plot(NULL,NULL,xlim=c(min(x),max(x)),ylim=c(0,6),
     xlab="time",ylab="rates",main=paste("deflated aggregate returns ","\n",ListNomActifs[nb_tr[i]],sep=""),cex.main=0.8)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(max,rev(min)),col="grey",border=NA)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(qet2max,rev(qet2min)),col="lightblue",border=NA)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(qetmax,rev(qetmin)),col="blue",border=NA)
lines(x,mean,type="l",col="red")
legend("topleft", inset=.01, title="Qantiles",
       c(expression(3*sigma),expression(2*sigma),expression(sigma),"av."), fill=c("grey","lightblue","blue","red"), horiz=TRUE, cex=0.4)
}
```
The total return must stay equal to 1 when cumulated total return is multiplied by deflator

Equity total return must be compared to the price of Deflator according to the standard deviation of the deflator
Equity total return must stay in between limits:
$$ 1 + \frac{q(\frac{x}{2})*SD}{\sqrt{N}}   and   1 + \frac{q(\frac{1-x}{2})*SD}{\sqrt{N}} $$

then for x = 0.02 (validation limit), and EIOPA curve for time step = 0.5

```{r fig4, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 5, fig.align = "center", echo=FALSE}
nb_tr=Nb_ZC+7
norm_inv=2.32634787 #loi normale inverse pour proba de 1%

SD<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr],2,sd)
D<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr],2,mean)
Av_return<-rep(1,length(D))

par(mfrow = c(1,1))
plot(Av_return,type='l',ylim = c(0.8,1.2), cex = 1.5,col="blue", lty=2, lwd=2, main="Quality test on equity")
line_up<-(Av_return+(-norm_inv)*SD/(N^0.5))
lines(line_up, lwd=1)
line_down<-(Av_return+norm_inv*SD/(N^0.5))
lines(line_down, lwd=1)

lines(D,col='red',cex=3, lwd=2)
legend("topright", inset=.02, title="Equity martingality)",
       c("Av. Total return","Expect. av. tot return","Stat. tolerances"), fill=c("red","blue","black"), horiz=TRUE, cex=0.6)

```

## correlation
```{r fig8, echo=FALSE}
list_assets<-c(1,2,Nb_ZC+6,Nb_ZC+7,Nb_ZC+8)
precision<-100
mat_cor<-array(0,dim=c(length(list_assets),length(list_assets)))
for (i in 1:precision){
  mat_cor<-cor(cube[i,,list_assets])+mat_cor
}
mat_cor<-mat_cor/precision
List_affichage<-ListNomActifs[list_assets]
cat(List_affichage)
print(mat_cor)
```
